_comment: SAMPLE DATA — This file is illustrative only. It shows the intended structure of an EchoCode investigation report. All values are fictional placeholders. No tests were actually executed to produce this file.

findings.title: Discount applied before tax calculation
findings.description: When a promotional discount is applied, the discount reduces the pre-tax subtotal. Tax is then calculated on the discounted amount. For certain discount codes the resulting tax figure is lower than expected, producing an incorrect final charge.
findings.note: Status is 'candidate' — this finding has not been confirmed as a defect. Confirmation requires successful reproduction in the demo application and a passing verification test.

findings.title: Rounding truncates fractional cents instead of rounding
findings.description: The final charge is converted to an integer number of cents using integer truncation (int(amount * 100)) rather than rounding (round(amount * 100)). For certain amounts this silently drops a fraction of a cent, causing a small but consistent undercharge.
findings.note: Status is 'candidate' — further investigation required before this can be considered a confirmed defect.

evidence.summary: Customer reported incorrect charge of $9.89 instead of expected $10.00 on order ORD-SAMPLE-001.
Prior fix applied in commit deadbeef: moved discount application to post-tax step to avoid tax base reduction.
Line 42: final_amount = int(subtotal_after_discount * tax_rate * 100). Discount reduces tax base; result is truncated rather than rounded.
